camel_example: aliyun cms DescribeMonitoringAgentHosts --region cn-hangzhou --Status Running --PageSize 10 --InstanceRegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PageNumber 1 --AliyunHost true --KeyWord host1 --SerialNumbers 'a1ab31a3-1234-40f2-9e95-c8caa8f00000' --SysomStatus running --InstanceIds 'i-a3d1q1pm2f9yr29e0000' --HostName hostNam1
description_en: You can call the DescribeMonitoringAgentHosts operation to query a list of all hosts, regardless of whether the CloudMonitor agent is installed
description_zh: 调用DescribeMonitoringAgentHosts接口查询所有已安装和未安装云监控插件的主机列表
kebab_example: aliyun cms describe-monitoring-agent-hosts --key-word host1 --host-name hostNam1 --instance-ids i-a3d1q1pm2f9yr29e0000 --serial-numbers a1ab31a3-1234-40f2-9e95-c8caa8f00000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --aliyun-host true --status Running --sysom-status running --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMonitoringAgentHosts

parameters.help_en: The keyword for a fuzzy search
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en:
The serial number of the host.

A globally unique serial number is generated after the CloudMonitor agent is successfully installed on a host. Hosts that are not Alibaba Cloud instances do not have an instance ID, but have a serial number.

Use this parameter to find a specific monitored host
parameters.help_zh:
主机序列号。

每台主机成功安装云监控插件之后会生成一个SerialNumber，具备全局唯一性。非阿里云主机无实例ID，有SerialNumber。

该参数可用于精准查找监控的任何一台主机
parameters.name: serial_numbers

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

10

20

50

100

Alibaba Cloud does not limit the maximum value of this parameter. However, setting this parameter to a large value may cause a timeout
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示记录条数。取值：

10
20
50
100

虽然目前阿里云未限制该参数的最大值，但是不建议设置的值过大，可能会导致超时无法正常获取
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The region where the instance resides
parameters.name: instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter for Alibaba Cloud Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances. Valid values:

true (default): Returns only ECS instances.

false: Returns only hosts that are not ECS instances
parameters.help_zh:
阿里云主机（ECS）。取值：
true（默认值）：过滤出所有阿里云主机（ECS）。
false：过滤出所有非阿里云主机
parameters.name: aliyun_host

parameters.help_en:
The status of the host. Valid values:

Running: The host is running.

Stopped: The host is stopped, the agent is not installed, or the agent installation failed
parameters.help_zh:
主机状态。取值：
Running：运行中。
Stopped：已停止、未安装或安装失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The status of SysOM. Valid values:

installing: SysOM is being enabled.

running: SysOM is running.

stopped: SysOM is stopped.

uninstalling: SysOM is being disabled
parameters.help_zh:
SysOM的开启状态。取值：

installing：开启中。
running：运行中。
stopped：已停止。
uninstalling：关闭中
parameters.name: sysom_status
